mapper.select:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN u.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active, SUM(CASE WHEN u.is_active = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS suspended,
SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM membership ms WHERE ms.user_id = u.user_id AND ms.status IS NULL AND ms.end_date >= CURDATE() ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid, 0 AS expired, SUM(CASE WHEN u.is_active = 1 AND up.gender = '남자' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS maleActive, SUM(CASE WHEN u.is_active = 1 AND up.gender = '여자' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS femaleActive, 0 AS maleExpired, 0 AS femaleExpired FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.user_id = up.user_id JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = u.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 WHERE u.role = 'MEMBER'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS newJoin FROM users u JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = u.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 WHERE u.role = 'MEMBER'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS frozen, SUM(CASE WHEN up.gender='남자' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS frozenMale, SUM(CASE WHEN up.gender='여자' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS frozenFemale FROM member_freeze f JOIN users u ON f.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.user_id = up.user_id WHERE #{date} BETWEEN f.freeze_start AND f.freeze_end

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT er.user_id) FROM exercise_records er JOIN users u ON u.user_id = er.user_id JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = er.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 WHERE u.role = 'MEMBER' AND er.record_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tm.member_id) FROM trainer_members tm JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = tm.member_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 ) AS assigned, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT er.user_id) FROM exercise_records er JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = er.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 WHERE er.recommended_routine_id IS NOT NULL AND er.record_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND er.user_id IN ( SELECT tm2.member_id FROM trainer_members tm2 JOIN user_gym ug2 ON ug2.user_id = tm2.member_id AND ug2.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug2.is_active = 1 ) ) AS completed
